lines.text: You think Manhattan was bought with cash.
lines.display: YOU THINK MANHATTAN WAS BOUGHT WITH CASH

lines.text: In sixteen sixty-seven, Britain traded New York for a three-kilometer island in Indonesia.
lines.display: BRITAIN TRADED NEW YORK FOR A 3KM ISLAND

lines.text: Pulau Run, hidden in Indonesia's Banda Sea, the world's only source of nutmeg.
lines.display: INDONESIA'S BANDA ISLANDS: THE WORLD'S ONLY NUTMEG

lines.text: Back then, one sack of nutmeg bought an entire estate in London.
lines.display: NUTMEG WAS WORTH MORE THAN GOLD

lines.text: Thirty-nine British sailors held the island under Dutch naval siege for fifteen hundred days.
To end the war, Britain kept Manhattan, while the Dutch seized full control of the spice trade.
lines.display: 1667 TREATY OF BREDA SEALED THE DEAL

lines.text: Today, Manhattan is worth trillions. And Run is a quiet village of fifteen hundred people.
The worst real estate trade in human history.
lines.display: THE WORST TRADE IN HUMAN HISTORY
